recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missed link/order portion of FHIR-11453 while preserving the later FHIR-19572 Conformance guidance and avoiding future drift from a duplicated module list.
issue_request: FHIR-11453 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core modules-page correction from the DSTU2 ballot. It asked to change "What information is going to be exchanged" to a question, move that bullet to the last position, add links to the content domains, and add a sentence guiding readers to the remaining sections.
initial_application: The Jira comment says svn @10160. In git history, commit 6cab91a3e08dbbcd0ccdff56628ddcaef60dde30 applied #11453 by adding the question mark, moving the bullet to the end of the then-current list, and adding the remaining-sections sentence in source/modules.html. It did not add a content-domain link.
additional_context: source/modules.html remains in the current build through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini. Later FHIR-19572 added the Conformance bullet to the same list, which left the FHIR-11453 content question no longer last. Subsequent module evolution also made the hard-coded list of remaining areas incomplete compared with the included module index below.
reconciliation: Changed source/modules.html to place the content question after the later Conformance bullet, link it to the content modules in the included module index, and replace the stale hard-coded area list with a durable reference to the complete module index below.
source_changes: source/modules.html: moved the content-question bullet after the Conformance bullet, added a link to the content modules below, and replaced the stale hard-coded remaining-area list with a reference to the complete module index.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive later issue added the Conformance bullet to the same list; it was preserved while restoring FHIR-11453's content-question ordering.
